title: General analysis (scripted diagnostic): uploaded CSV -> summary
description: DIAGNOSTIC fixture, not a model run: a scripted driver for the analysis profile. Upload a CSV first and create the task with it as the only input; the labelled summarize.py summarises the first CSV under inputs/ into outputs/summary.json and outputs/columns.csv. Every model event is labelled scripted.

args.summary: Scripted diagnostic: row and column summary of the uploaded CSV.
